scripts.build: vite build --config extension/vite.config.ts && npm run copy-assets
scripts.copy-assets: copyfiles -u 1 extension/manifest.json dist/ && cp dist/src/popup/index.html dist/popup.html && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/popup.html', fs.readFileSync('dist/popup.html','utf8').replace(/src=\"[^\"]*popup\.js\"/g, 'src=\"./popup.js\"'));" && rm -rf dist/src
